messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "never take in larger amounts or for longer than prescribed"
set: ["never take in larger amounts or for longer than prescribed", "never take in larger amounts", "do not use in larger amounts or for longer than recommended", "do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "do not take more than prescribed", "do not take more or less than prescribed", "do not take it for longer than 14 days", "do not take in higher doses or more often than prescribed", "longer than measurable in blood", "take as prescribed", "do not take more or less or more often than prescribed", "results take longer", "do not take more than your prescribed dose", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "take for full prescribed length of time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "never take in larger amounts",
    "do not use in larger amounts or for longer than recommended",
    "do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended",
    "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor",
    "do not take more than prescribed",
    "do not take more or less than prescribed",
    "do not take more or less or more often than prescribed",
    "do not take more than your prescribed dose",
    "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to"
  ],
  "alias": "do not take more than prescribed"
}
